groups.name: Extraordinary Minister of Holy Communion
groups.description: If you are 16 years or older and a confirmed Catholic, you can be a Eucharist Minister and distribute Holy Communion during the Mass.

groups.name: Lectors
groups.description: A Lector proclaims God’s word to us through Biblical readings selected for the day. Lectors should be a confirmed Catholic who possesses the ability to read the texts with a loud, clear voice.
